name: 写真を中央に置いたファイルプレビュー
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Actual Lighthouse component LH15-0008, ONE photo-file preview with information and edit controls. No whole source app or device.
Image1 ORIGINAL is primary for control glyph geometry, optical weight, alignment, spacing/fine details: round information button upper left, original circled-i and original outlined pencil-with-baseline edit symbol. Use source preview region x0 y300 w1179 h1938 only, excluding top file header and bottom share toolbar. Image2 ORIGINAL-derived photo is immutable existing media: use this exact photo/crop of the kitchen, sunflower window, bread on board left and dark kettle right. Preserve all photographed objects, colors, their positions and crop; do not regenerate a different kitchen or recolor it. Image3 OUR MOCK is secondary guide to Japanese text and overall component arrangement. Correct rough glyphs from original and remove mock's broad mint edit fill. Image4 approved bus supplies forest-green gradient action and quiet white materials only.
Only visible UI copy: "編集". Meiryo Regular14/24px tracking0, no bold heading. No other title, label or invented content.
Composition compact logical width390px, height roughly400px: small information button upper-left; photo full component width with same1.79:1 crop centered below; single accessible edit action beneath, within content width. Keep these three existing parts only; reduce empty height carefully without crowding. Information and photo stay separate, not nested repetitive cards. Subtle photo corners; pure#FFFFFF canvas and white surface, soft restrained shadow/neutral edge if required.
Edit is the only primary action: smooth forest-green gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E with white pencil and white 編集 label, gentle light rim and small soft shadow, rounded rectangle/pill appropriate to original. Supporting info control neutral slate#526173, glyph proportions from original. Preserve source photo's warm wood/green/yellow natural colors as media. No extra palette accents, mint panels, random icon color, neon or plastic gloss.
Originals control disputed details; mock secondary. No source file name, count, star/menu header, share/comment/delete/link toolbar, navigation, English, watermark, IDs, board labels, captions or invented controls. Static design candidate, no interaction claim.
reviewNotes: 原図・写真原本・自作を全て開いて比較。原図の鉛筆形状とブランド緑グラデーション編集操作、白面を生成。目視で写真の細部／トリミングが再生成され厳密な原メディア保持を満たさず、情報アイコンは原図の塗り円より自作の外枠へ寄り、編集ラベルは指定Regularより太く見える。これらは要修正として保存、元の写真を変更せず保持。実装・編集性・承認未確認。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
